verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's own docs say it collects time and attendance data for running payroll, and that approved timesheets sync to QuickBooks. That covers time entries feeding payroll at a marketing-claim level. Overtime is never mentioned, and the time-to-payroll flow is only described in brief marketing copy. Missing for 10: any evidence that overtime is calculated or carried into the payroll run, detailed documentation of how hourly entries land in a pay run, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have hourly time entries and overtime flow directly into the payroll run

citations.quote: Your Payroll AI proactively collects time and attendance data from your employees, spots inconsistencies, and texts your admin updates—letting you run payroll from anywhere.
Create and share schedules and approve timesheets from anywhere, and it syncs to QuickBooks.
